backend_servers.description: Backend servers (the pool traffic is balanced across). Empty keeps the example pool the package ships (app1–app4).

haproxy_chroot.description: Path to chroot directory for HAProxy.

haproxy_log_addr.description: Syslog server address for HAProxy logs.

haproxy_maxconn.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections per process in defaults.

haproxy_pidfile.description: Path to the HAProxy PID file.

haproxy_retries.description: Number of retries when a server is marked down.

haproxy_static_server_addr.description: IP address for the static backend server.

haproxy_static_server_port.description: Port for the static backend server.

haproxy_stats_socket.description: Path to the stats Unix socket.

haproxy_timeout_http_keep_alive.description: Timeout for the HTTP keep-alive phase.

haproxy_timeout_http_request.description: Timeout for the HTTP request phase.

hsts.description: Send HSTS header on responses (mode http). Only enable once HTTPS works.

https_port.description: Frontend HTTPS bind port (used when TLS is enabled).

log_level.description: Log target for the defaults section (usually 'global').

mode.description: Proxy mode: http (L7) or tcp (L4 passthrough).

redirect_to_https.description: Redirect plain HTTP to HTTPS (http-request redirect scheme https unless ssl_fc).

ssl_cert_pem.description: PEM file for 'crt' — HAProxy expects cert + key + chain concatenated in ONE file (or a directory of them).

ssl_ciphers.description: TLS 1.2 cipher list (ssl-default-bind-ciphers, Mozilla Intermediate). Empty = HAProxy default. Unset on AlmaLinux keeps the system-wide crypto policy (PROFILE=SYSTEM), as the package ships it.

ssl_min_version.description: Minimum TLS version (ssl-min-ver). Intermediate = TLSv1.2; Modern = TLSv1.3.

timeout_connect.description: Max time to wait for a connection to a server.

tls_enabled.description: Terminate TLS on the frontend (bind :443 ssl). Needs a combined PEM.
